resources.string: Translate German, remember the words and check your writing, all in one app.
Words with a dictionary card and whole texts, from and into German.
Translated words go to your vocabulary, and spaced repetition and trainers help them stick.
Record a conversation in German and get the transcript, a summary and exercises.
Fixes mistakes in your German text. Type it or take a photo of it.
German words and texts are translated into it.
Translating words and the AI features need your own API key, which you can get for free.
Text goes to the provider you choose, and only when you use these features.
Text translation also works without a key: the app uses offline models on your phone.
